# Per-link click limits

`POST /api/v1/links` accepts an optional `maxClicks` (1–1,000,000):

```json
{ "longUrl": "https://example.com/offer", "maxClicks": 100 }
```

The link redirects until it has recorded `maxClicks` clicks, then `GET /{code}` returns `410 Gone`.
`GET /api/v1/links/{code}` shows `maxClicks` (`null` = unlimited). Existing links are unlimited.

## Behaviour notes

- Soft limit: clicks are recorded in the background, so a burst of concurrent redirects can pass the cap by the number of clicks still queued.
- Capped links read their live click count from the database on each redirect; uncapped links keep using the redirect cache.
- Schema: migration `AddMaxClicks` adds a nullable `MaxClicks` column to `ShortLinks`; rolling it back drops the column.
